cases.name: channel-budget
cases.source_definition: Original 48000 Hz PCM16 stereo; seven sinusoidal components at 157,311,617,1223,2441,4871,9743 Hz, phase index*0.19, each amplitude0.078, 96-sample endpoint ramps. Samples0..35999:left-only;36000..71999:right gain0.05; remaining: alternating sides in12000-sample blocks. Quantize round(value*32767).

quantization: Bounded per-band reconstruction-error allocation within one shared mono/stereo element budget, preserving each channel global gain, scale DPCM and section boundaries.
quality_metric: Unweighted source SNR after removing 1024 priming samples and final padding; generated test inputs only.
